about.how-it-works-desc: ImmichDrive uses the Windows Cloud Files API to show your photos as placeholder files. They appear in File Explorer with real thumbnails but take no space until you open one; then ImmichDrive downloads just that file from your server.
about.immich-desc: The self-hosted photo and video backup that ImmichDrive shows in File Explorer.
app.description: Browse your Immich photos and videos in File Explorer, with thumbnails and files that download on demand.
connection.folder: Drive folder (where it appears in File Explorer)
connection.key-not-saved: Your API key could not be saved, so you will need to enter it again after ImmichDrive restarts.
connection.key-unreadable: Your saved API key could not be read on this Windows account.
connection.move-note: Your photos reappear at the new location and the old folder is removed. Nothing is deleted from Immich.
connection.not-needed: Delete, update, API key management and admin permissions are not needed.
connection.partners: Libraries shared with you in Partners
connection.permissions-intro: In Immich, create or edit your key under Account Settings → API Keys. Select these permissions; All permissions is not needed.
connection.subtitle: Point the drive at your Immich server.
connection.test-ok: Reached Immich as {{user}}. This checks your URL and the {{permission}} permission; select the permissions listed above for the features you use.
connection.test-rejected: Check that your API key is correct and includes {{permission}}. Select the permissions listed above in Immich's API key settings.
connection.test-unreachable: Check the server URL and that your Immich server is reachable.
connection.upload: Upload files through the Upload folder
drive.key-rejected: Immich rejected the API key. Check the key and its {{permission}} permission in Settings.
drive.key-unreadable: Your saved API key could not be read. Enter it again in Settings.
drive.pin-issue: Some pinned photos could not be downloaded. Retrying in the background.
drive.sync-issue: Some photos could not be synced. Refresh to retry.
flyout.offline: Your photos are still listed. Retrying in the background.
flyout.offline-since: Your photos are still listed, last updated {{time}}. Retrying in the background.
home.get-started: Add your Immich server to get started.
home.offline: Your photos are still listed, but they can't be opened until the server answers. Retrying in the background.
status.sync-issue: Some photos could not be synced
